criteria.text: The participant demonstrates understanding and voluntarily signs an informed consent form
The participant is ≥ 18 years of age

The participant has a histologically or cytologically documented, incurable or metastatic solid tumor that is refractory to or intolerant of all standard therapy or for which no standard therapy is available
The participant has a histologically confirmed diagnosis of ER+, HER2- mBC not amenable to resection or radiation therapy with curative intent
The participant has measurable disease per Response Evaluation Criteria in Solid Tumors Version 1.1 (RECIST v1.1)
The participant has adequate organ function

Females of childbearing age are not pregnant at the time of Screening/beginning of treatment and agree to either abstain from sexual intercourse or use highly effective methods of contraception (for up to 3 months after last dose of study drug)
Males sexually active with a woman of childbearing age agree to use a barrier method of birth control during and after the study (up to 3 months after last dose of study drug)
The participant has a life expectancy of <3 months, as determined by the Investigator
The participant received treatment with any local or systemic antineoplastic therapy (including chemotherapy, hormonal therapy, or radiation) within 3 weeks prior to first dose of BTX-A51
The participant has a chronic use of corticosteroids in excess of 10 mg daily of prednisone or equivalent within 4 weeks prior to first dose of BTX-A51
The participant experienced major trauma or major surgery within 4 weeks prior to first dose of BTX-A51
The participant has adverse events from prior anti-cancer therapy that have not resolved to Grade ≤1 except for alopecia or Grade ≤2 immunotherapy-related thyroid toxicity
The participant has a history of, or known, central nervous system (CNS) disease involvement, or prior history of NCI CTCAE Grade ≥3 drug-related CNS toxicity
The participant has clinically significant cardiac disease
The participant has an active uncontrolled systemic fungal, bacterial, mycobacterial, or viral infection
The participant has a known positive test result for human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) or acquired immune deficiency syndrome (AIDS)
The participant has active hepatitis C virus (HCV) or hepatitis B virus (HBV)
The participant has a second primary malignancy that has not been in remission for greater than 3 years

The participant has any serious underlying medical (e.g., pulmonary, renal, hepatic, gastrointestinal, or neurological) or psychiatric condition (e.g., alcohol or drug abuse, dementia or altered mental status) or any issue that would limit compliance with study requirements
The participant is pregnant, lactating, or breastfeeding
The participant is participating or plans to participate in another interventional clinical study

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: These questions are about the trial "A Study of BTX-A51 in People With Advanced Solid Tumor and Breast Cancer". Your earlier answers already covered 7 of its rules. I'll ask about the rest of its rules one at a time. You can skip any question, and "I don't know" is always fine.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Are you willing to read and sign an informed consent form to show you understand the study details and agree to participate?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: Yes, I'm willing to read and sign the informed consent form. I always read every report carefully before agreeing to anything.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. To confirm, do you feel you understand the study details well enough to participate?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: Yes, I understand the details. As an engineer, I read every report carefully, so I'm confident in my understanding.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. To confirm, are you 18 years of age or older?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: Yes, I am 49 years old, so I am definitely 18 or older.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. Do you have adequate organ function, meaning your liver, kidneys, and heart are working well enough for this study?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: I don't know my specific organ function metrics like liver enzymes or kidney clearance rates. I feel fully active and have no recent cardiac events, but I don't have the lab values to confirm adequate function.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. Since you don't have the lab values, have you had any recent blood tests or check-ups that showed your liver, kidneys, and heart are functioning well?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: I don't know the specific results of my recent blood tests or check-ups. I haven't shared those details, so I can't confirm if my liver, kidneys, and heart are functioning well enough based on lab values.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. Are you currently pregnant? Also, if you are sexually active, are you willing to use highly effective contraception during the study and for 3 months after the last dose?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: Not applicable, I'm male. I don't know the specific contraception requirements for male participants in this study.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. Since you are male, are you currently sexually active with a woman of childbearing age? If so, would you be willing to use a barrier method of birth control during the study and for 3 months after your last dose?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: I don't know if I am currently sexually active or what the specific contraception requirements are for male participants in this study.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. Based on your current health, do you expect to live for at least 3 more months?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: I don't know my specific prognosis or life expectancy. I am fully active and working full time, but I can't predict how long I will live.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. In the last 4 weeks, have you been taking corticosteroids (like prednisone) regularly? If so, was the dose more than 10 mg per day?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: No, I do not take steroid pills like prednisone or dexamethasone every day.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. Have you had any major surgery or experienced major trauma in the last 4 weeks?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: I don't know if I've had any major surgery or trauma in the last 4 weeks. I haven't tracked that specific detail recently.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. Have you had any side effects from previous cancer treatments that are still ongoing or haven't improved to a mild level (Grade 1 or less), excluding hair loss or mild thyroid issues?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: I don't know if I have any ongoing side effects from my previous treatments. I haven't tracked specific toxicity grades for my prior alectinib or lorlatinib courses.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. Have you ever been diagnosed with a disease affecting your brain or spinal cord (CNS), or had severe side effects (Grade 3 or higher) from cancer treatment that impacted your brain or nerves?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: I don't have a history of other CNS diseases, but I do have brain metastases from my lung cancer. I haven't had severe treatment side effects impacting my brain or nerves, though the brain spots are untreated.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. Have you ever been diagnosed with a heart condition that is considered serious or significant, such as heart failure, a recent heart attack, or a serious heart rhythm problem?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: No, I haven't had a heart attack, stroke, or heart failure requiring hospital care in the last 6 months.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. Do you currently have any active infections, such as a fungal, bacterial, viral, or mycobacterial infection, that are not under control?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: I don't know if I have any active infections right now. My facts only cover HIV and hepatitis status, not general infections.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. Do you have any serious medical conditions (like lung, kidney, liver, stomach, or nerve issues) or mental health conditions that might make it hard for you to follow the study rules?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: I don't know if I have other serious medical conditions beyond my metastatic lung cancer. I have no history of other cancers, autoimmune diseases, or active infections like HIV or hepatitis.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. To help us understand your health better, do you have any serious conditions affecting your lungs, kidneys, liver, stomach, nerves, or mental health (like dementia or substance use) that might make it hard to follow study rules?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: I have metastatic non-small cell lung cancer with spread to the pleura, liver, and brain, but no leptomeningeal disease. I don't know about other specific conditions affecting those organs or mental health beyond what I've mentioned.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. Are you currently pregnant, or are you currently breastfeeding or lactating?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: Not applicable, I'm male.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Are you currently taking part in, or do you plan to join, any other clinical research studies?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: No, I am not currently participating in any other clinical research studies.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thank you, that's all my questions. Your record for this trial is ready, for you and your oncologist. They and the trial team decide whether it is right for you.
